target: How to Cook an LLM interactive article
purpose: PostTrainLLM helps learners understand model development by making inspectable decisions about data, training examples, feedback, and inference.

directions.name: Research kitchen
directions.audience: First-time LLM learners on the existing research site
directions.screenJob: Read a guided article and inspect inline decisions
directions.visualThesis: Existing dark research bench with editorial pacing
directions.typography: Bricolage headings; Geist prose; Geist Mono token data in implementation
directions.colorRoles: Ink canvas, teal actions, coral warnings
directions.signature: Each station exposes a data/weights/input-output change receipt
directions.risk: May feel technical for absolute beginners

directions.name: Annotated cookbook
directions.audience: Beginners arriving for an approachable explainer
directions.screenJob: Read a recipe and complete small preparation sheets
directions.visualThesis: Warm editorial paper with serif headings and margin annotations
directions.typography: Serif display, sans-serif reading, mono token annotations
directions.colorRoles: Paper canvas, forest actions, rust teaching notes
directions.interactionThesis: Complete a decision while reading its explanation
directions.signature: Recipe annotations translate kitchen actions into weight/data changes
directions.risk: A lighter editorial island differs from the surrounding dark site

directions.name: Guided workshop
directions.audience: Learners who prefer doing before reading
directions.screenJob: Complete stations while inspecting technical state
directions.visualThesis: A compact lesson console with persistent station navigation
directions.typography: Strong sans-serif headings, readable prose, mono inspector
directions.colorRoles: Slate canvas, amber station actions, neutral evidence
directions.layout: Station rail and dual-pane kitchen/technical workspace
directions.interactionThesis: Decision followed immediately by inspectable explanation
directions.signature: Prepared text and actual byte tokens visible side by side
directions.risk: Can feel more like a tool than an article

library.posture: Reuse existing Astro shell, project-native inputs, buttons and disclosure patterns; no added runtime dependency
